pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-rounded dark regions with moderate edge angularity. Spatial area is larger and more contiguous on the upper mid-flank, becoming smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A light-pigmented lattice of negative space forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are distinct, and pathways maintain a relatively uniform pixel thickness between 8 and 15 pixels in clear areas.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and dorsal ridge is visible as a dark, short-haired silhouette with high-frequency, low-amplitude serration against the background.
